build_FPN_DropBlock: build an FPN_DropBlock neck with DropBlock plugin for feature pyramid network with spatial dropout
build_FPN_DropBlock_custom_plugin: build an FPN_DropBlock neck with a custom plugin dict specifying drop_prob and block_size parameters
run_FPN_DropBlock_forward: run the forward pass of FPN_DropBlock on a tuple of 4D feature tensors from backbone
review_FPN_DropBlock_forward: review the FPN_DropBlock forward method that builds laterals, top-down path, and outputs with optional plugin
refactor_FPN_DropBlock_plugin: refactor the FPN_DropBlock plugin application in the top-down path to support multiple dropout strategies
